description: Land Title Settlement Department - Netiyapaana, Rambukkana D/S Division, Kegalle District - Cad. Map No. 610215 (23/0791)
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act. It contains a declaration by the Commissioner of Title Settlement determining ownership of specific land parcels (Plot numbers 1:1 through 1:19) in the Kegalle District, including details of parcel numbers, extents, and ownership status (all owned by "The State"). The content falls squarely within the Land Gazette category as it involves land registrations, property ownership determinations, and land title settlements.
